v.1.1.4.0_401005

[b]New Content/Update: Gifts from the Rifts[/b]
[list][*] Plushie Goat – It’s so plushie I’m gonna die!
[*] Bald Cap – I don’t know who thought this was a good idea
[*] Detective Hat – Detective Pika… I mean Pilgor, at your service
[*] Noir Fedora – For your shady deals
[*] Frog Hat – Didn’t I do it for you?
[*] Kettle Helmet – Oh man, I thought it was a tea kettle helmet
[*] Plague Mask – It’s giving lockdown 2020
[*] Rain Coat Hat – Pilginton
[*] Skull Hermit – Some voodoo stuff
[*] Tiara – Time for the princess treatment you deserve
[*] Trenchcoat – Perfect match with the ‘Noir Fedora’
[*] Mime Outfit – *mimes in French*
[*] Rain Coat – The Rainy season starts soon
[*] Security Outfit – Gives you a false sense of security
[*] Viking Armour – Bring out your inner shield-maiden
[*] Detective Suit – Perfect match with the ‘Detective Hat’
[*] Candle Wings – I mean, why not?
[*] Hotdog Costume – Yummy!
[*] Plushie Jetpack – Ofc the Plushie Goat needs its own jetpack
[*] Bat Wings – Air dog wings
[*] Mime Feet – Thanks, I hate it
[*] Mime Makeup –This is kinda cool tho 
[*] Candelabra Horns – Cozy
[*] Demon Horns – Overcompensating a bit, ey?
[*] Odin Horns – Keep it simple
[*] Plushie Horns – Aww, cute!
[*] Pool Noodles Horns – AKA ‘Noodles of Shame’
[*] Reindeer Horns – You can hang curtains with these
[/list]
[b]2 New Events:[/b]
[list][*] Birthday Crack – Only the legal stuff
[*] Birthday Present – Wow, who doesn't like presents?!
[/list]
[b]Additional Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the ‘Add-On’ tab to the main menu for easier access, instead of only being in the customization menu
[*] The instinct ‘Let your hair grow to 25 meters’ from the Grass Hair gear will now take around 20 minutes to complete instead of the previous 2 hours. Sounds a lot more reasonable, IMO
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list][*] Fixed several crashes that occurred in the game
[*] Fixed a lot of quality of life gameplay bugs
[*] Fixed several issues that occurred when joining multiplayer sessions
[*] Players are now able to play offline after obtaining the DLCs
[*] Fixed the gear placement on the Goat Type ‘Non-Player Character’ to make it fit better
[*] All free updates and DLCs have a green text in the customization menu except Multiverse – that is now fixed. Finally
[*] Fixed the Multiverse event ‘High Roller ' – the stone should now always spawn
[*] Fixed a bunch of crashes that could appear while being chaotic. Lol what
[*] Fixed the Multiverse event ‘Walk the Human’ – Pilgor will always move with the leash
[*] Fixed the Multiverse event ‘Hoarding Oars’ – players will no longer see a delay before the rocks fall apart
[*] The compass will now work when players are flying on the Broom gear
[*] Changing the v-sync option will now take effect immediately and no longer requires a restart of the game. I have no idea what this means, but it sounds like a good thing
[*] The FPS will no longer be limited if the ‘Limit Frame Rate’ setting is set to false
[*] The Slinger Saddle gear will now suit the Goat Types from Multiverse better
[*] The Chain Spirit Helmet will now suit the Puppet Goat's head better
[*] When headbutting a stone wall, only the part you headbutt will be destroyed instead of the whole wall disappearing
[*] Fixed a broom-related crash. Rita Skeeter will cover this story
[*] The Flying Broom Gear Controller Steering Mode setting should now work properly
[*] Client goats will no longer get stuck upon recovering from the ragdoll state if they are ragdolled for more than 1 minute or if angry NPCs and cars keep hitting the player
[*] The time and date for resetting saves will now update correctly after resetting the save
[*] Gears that were unlocked in the store after completing an event will now be displayed in the Wardrobe when any type of sorting is selected
[*] The ability button will no longer stop working after opening and closing the Wardrobe quickly
[*] The correct number of chaos points will now be displayed near the events in the Events tab of the Pause Menu
[*] The Mastermind board in the Knowledge Stone Rift of Multiverse is fixed. The pegs placed on the hint panel will now have the correct colours both for the host and the client
[*] NPCs will no longer hover in mid-air. Aww dang it
[*] Players will now be able to escape the effect from the Tethermancer Boots if it’s being used on them
[*] Fixed level clipping issues in the Mountain area. Objects should now spawn more smoothly. Nice
[*] Fixed a crash that could appear when jumping on the Hexagons in the Multiverse
[*] The Human Pet Goat Type will now be able to wear all back gears without them sitting inside the Human Pet's body. Yikes
[*] Fixed the missing image on the screen in the 'Dr. Pilgor' event
[/list]

notes.title: Super Duper Pack + free update OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44753199/9c3df36e79acc1ae50e1203b3516a648cd7daf56.jpg[/img]

[h2]With goat power comes [i]some[/i] responsibility[/h2]

[b]Is it a bird? Is it a plane? No, it’s the heroes no one asked for.[/b]
Will they help you save the world? Probably not. More likely the opposite. 
The [b]Super Duper Pack[/b] contains 20 new gears, 6 with abilities, 6 new instincts, and 2 new playable goats. 

Alongside all the superhero nonsense, a [b]free update[/b] is also available from today. You can now save up to [b]50 unique gear sets[/b] in the customization menu.

The paid Super Duper Pack add-on and the free update are out now!

Watch the [b]Super Duper Pack[/b] trailer here:
[previewyoutube=cUWQAoWk64k;full][/previewyoutube]

Buy now, regret later:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3299590/Goat_Simulator_3__Super_Duper_Pack

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
v.1.1.2.0_383035

[h3]Who would’ve known we would release a superhero goat pack?! We’ve also added some quality-of-life fixes to the base game as a free update, plus smashing a lot of bugs. [/h3]

[b]New Free Update[/b]
[list][*]You can now save Gear Sets in the Customization menu. See, we listen to you 
[*] You now need to hold the button to reset your progress to avoid accidentally deleting your save by mistake
[*] You will now be able to see when your progress was last reset before deleting a save[/list]
[b]New Paid Add-on –  Super Duper Pack[/b]
[list][*]20 new gears, 6 with abilities
[*] 4 new Goat Sets – Doctor Degree, Krimson Kerosene, Supergoat, Methanos
[*] 2 new Goat Types – Stump & Miss Immovable[/list]
[b]The complete Super Duper list:[/b]
[list]
[*] Doctor Degree's Fur – If Elsa and Dr. Manhattan had a goat child this would be it
[*] Doctor Degree's Frosted Tips – Forbidden ice cream
[*] Doctor Degree's Cryo Device – A must-have for every ice goat 
[*] Doctor Degree's Cryo Boots – Are they cold to wear?
[*] Krimson Kerosene's Fur – For that extra glow
[*] Krimson Kerosene's Outfit – Years of built-up rage in this outfit
[*] Krimson Kerosene's Headpiece – It’s pretty neat
[*] Krimson Kerosene's Boots – Kick people in style
[*] Supergoat's Suit – Generic superhero outfit
[*] Supergoat's Helmet – With a generic superhero helmet
[*] Supergoat's Mask – Let’s not forget a generic superhero mask
[*] Supergoat's Hood – And a generic superhero hood
[*] Supergoat's Cape – You can’t have a generic superhero without a cape
[*] Supergoat's Boots – Generic superhero boots as the cherry on top, or bottom I guess
[*] Methanos' Fur – What did it cost? Everything
[*] Methanos' Fumes – Not sure what this does actually but it’s probably cool
[*] Methanos' Boots – Gas-powered teleportation has never been easier
[*] Miss Immovable – Originally from the Fantastic Six 
[*] Stump – I am Stump
[*] Sidekick – Very satisfying to use[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list][*] 'The Destroyer' tape will no longer disappear when you try to bring it to the cinema to complete 'The Lost Tapes' event. No more hide-and-seek
[*] Fixed an issue where NPCs wouldn't spawn while the player was on the broom
[*] The sound of the VR Head Set Gear will now go back to normal after returning to the Title Screen
[*] Grappling Bow Gear will now have visible animations 
[*] NPCs will be displayed normally when playing the Artsy Fartsy event. They weren’t before?
[*] Fixed icon issues on buttons from the Gear Competition events
[*] The game will no longer crash when using the broom to fly in Goofville while playing the Multiverse of Nonense DLC
[*] Fixed a translation issue in the Fishing event where you get Bob from the Gear Competition
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred when opening the menu twice after completing the ‘Crack in Time’ event
[*] Players will no longer get stuck in the Multiverse portal when flying in with the broom
[*] The ability effect from the Wand Horn Gear will no longer remain on respawned vehicles
[*] NPC's mobile phones will no longer get stuck in the air
[*] It will now be possible to accept/decline a mini-game invitation when flying on a broom when using the controller. The future is now guys
[*] When using the chains from the Chain Spirit Boots Gear on the broom, objects will start following it
[*] Players will now hear the broom honk sound when the host is flying it. It’s getting too real
[*] Fixed an issue that occurred when you flew into the Satellite Dish using the broom. Man this broom has no chill
[*] If you lick or headbutt the broom, it will now display its name so you know you have licked or kicked it. Very important
[*] The Puppet Goat will no longer look scary in the menu when playing on Low Settings
[*] When equipping the 'Puppet Goat' type, you will no longer be able to access the 'Body' tab if it's empty. Sounds great
[*] The game will no longer crash when trying to log out from the Settings menu during an active game session
[*] The game will no longer crash for the player if the host’s owl picks up an object. Hoot hoot
[*] We had some issues with more crashes after the latest release – this will hopefully calm down with this patch, but if you keep experiencing crashes, let us know. And if you know how to reproduce it step by step, even better! Fingers (or hooves) crossed that it has been solved now[/list]
